text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: "Hey, that commercial just now...! <chrname>!?"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's wonderful as always! I wonder 
what kind of run she'll show us next?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go to the racetrack again! Let's 
cheer for her as she runs—"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —...Amazing. Incredible...! So cool!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! Someday, I'm going to be 
just like you, <nickname>-san!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—I'll show everyone I can become a 
legendary Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That's amazing! What a wonderful 
commercial...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: "...I've gotta shine even brighter too♪"

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Haiseiko-san! It's time!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪

Feelings that have once sprouted will 
never fade.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text: Hm? Huh...? Where's <nickname>'s corner?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Are you a fan of hers?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to guide you. I shall tell you 
all about that girl.
A bond once tied will never unravel.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I need to turn up this heat even further.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Heeey! Speed Symboli, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Come... let's take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. Are you ready?
The Twinkle Series continues on—

As long as Umamusume and humans—continue 
to dream.
